open_items: The number randomized and per-arm counts at assignment are not printed. The recruitment count cannot establish when exclusions occurred relative to assignment.

Tables II and III do not report regression N, estimator, observation unit, standard-error method, or clustering. Participant-level independence cannot be confirmed. The pooled RAT comparison likewise omits its analysis unit and comparison-specific counts.

The retained pooled RAT result reports a p-value but does not identify its test, observation unit, or handling of repeated rounds. Its actual uncertainty basis remains unreported; se_basis is coded unclear under the current extraction-spec.md Field notes and codebook Section 10. Participant-level precision cannot be confirmed. This is a reporting gap, not an unresolved vocabulary conflict. The other flagged se_basis fields belonged to models excluded under rule 5.

The excluded NoAI coefficients are control minus treatment for the named Low-AI-versus-NoAI contrasts. Their printed signs and orientation metadata are preserved in fixes[].old.record for audit only; they are not eligible effects for downstream calculations.

Condition regressions adjust for actual AI use and time spent on the task, both post-treatment variables. The AUT/RAT condition coefficients and DAT placeholders have been removed from estimates under extraction-spec.md rule 5. No equivalent unadjusted AUT, DAT, or individual-arm RAT contrasts are printed.
Full-sample AUT and DAT arm means and performance SDs are absent; no performance SDs are printed for RAT. No standardized effect, confidence interval, or participant-level SD can be transcribed.

DAT regression coefficients and uncertainty were deliberately omitted as nonsignificant. The associated models also adjust for task duration and actual AI use; these DAT contrasts are listed in not_extracted rather than retained as eligible null-statistic estimates.
The paper does not explain whether each semantic-distance score pools responses across all task rounds or is calculated separately for each round.

The paper does not identify who or what judged RAT responses correct. The retained RAT measure remains null under extraction-spec.md and codebook Section 6, which explicitly allow an unspecified scorer; no additional coding convention is needed. The scoring procedure remains a reporting gap. Convergent outcomes remain outside pooled creativity estimates.
Whether the regression-table significance stars follow the Results section’s Holm-adjustment statement is unclear. No p-value is inferred from absent stars.
The experimental LLM model, provider, release year, participant countries, and any preregistration are not identified.
The citation and retrieval records identify an IEEE version of record with different pagination. Its page-by-page identity with the saved open MIPRO copy remains unverified.
notes: Reconciled on 2026-10-10 against the complete markdown conversion and all pages of the saved PDF, including the references. Tables I-III were checked directly in PDF text; Tables II-III were also recovered with pymupdf find_tables. Figure 1 was inspected in memory and contains a task-and-chat screenshot, not outcome statistics. No appendix or supplement is present in the document. Prior extractor disagreements are recorded in resolutions, including country representation and difference_is discrepancies; the first-round verifier and mechanical-check decisions are recorded in fixes and kept, and the second-round decisions are recorded in fixes2 and kept2. Other differences in wording and source detail were consolidated using the checked passages. Neither extractor had a unique estimate. After the fixer review, the pooled RAT AI-availability comparison is the only retained estimate. The adjusted AUT/RAT condition regressions, their DAT counterparts, and the screening form’s actual-AI-user contrasts are individually listed in not_extracted. No replacement estimate was computed. Agreed fields were independently checked: retained people counts come from Section III.D and Table I; recruitment is not substituted for randomization, and study cell counts are not assumed to be model-specific counts. AUT and DAT distances compare responses within each participant, so construct is flexibility, question is with_ai, and higher_is is more_creative. RAT accuracy is convergent with higher_is more_accurate. AI access was available during production in the AI arms, even when unused; outcome_with_ai is true. Assignment was between participants; repeated rounds did not switch conditions, so within_person is null. The analysis unit remains null because the paper does not establish whether scores were aggregated across rounds. No across_people or after_ai outcome is reported. All printed numerical estimates were rechecked: the condition coefficients and SEs in Tables II-III, and the pooled RAT percentage means and p-value bound in Section V. The four DAT records are excluded because their omitted coefficients come from the same post-treatment-adjusted models. Printed signs and percentage units are retained; no effect, standard error, interval, sample-size sum, or p-value has been computed. The screening sample_overlap record is empty and the paper names no shared sample; shared_sample remains null. Fixer review on 2026-10-10 covered the entire markdown conversion and all six PDF pages, including references; Tables II-III were recovered with pymupdf.find_tables and Figure 1 was inspected in memory. The ten excluded records remain verbatim in fixes[].old.record as historical evidence. The two disputed AUT maximum-distance quotations and their numerical values are correct; intervening table columns caused the mechanical text-match failures. For the retained pooled RAT contrast, measure is null because the scoring method is unspecified, as explicitly permitted by the current rules. se_basis is unclear because the paper prints a p-value but does not establish its uncertainty basis. These two coding cases are resolved; the underlying reporting gaps remain. The earlier resolutions, fixes, and kept are retained as review history and are superseded by fixes2 and kept2 where applicable. Second-round review on 2026-10-11 read the complete markdown conversion and extracted text from all six PDF pages, including references; no appendix or supplement is present or named. Tables II-III were also recovered with pymupdf.find_tables. The two re-verifier flags were checked against the current extraction-spec.md and creativity-codebook.md. All retained numerical values, source quotations, study data, exclusions, and earlier review records are unchanged.
